objective: Instrumentar Gate4D R6 para capturar de forma durable stage, batch exacto, excepcion y resultado de rollback. No desplegar vistas: toda ejecucion DDL debe terminar en rollback deliberado. Publicar evidencia JSON como artifact y postcheck fisico 0/4.

actions.old:
- name: Execute GO batches transactionally
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS=true
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
actions.new:
- name: R6 instrumented rollback-only diagnostic
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, pathlib, sys, traceback, pymssql
          report={'job':'RRR-GATE4D-R6-INSTRUMENTED-ROLLBACK-DIAGNOSTIC-20260914','stage':'init','batch':None,'batch_count':None,'batches':[],'exception':None,'rollback':None,'diagnostic_outcome':None}
          out=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'rrr_gate4_r6_diagnostic.json'
          conn=None; cur=None
          try:
              report['stage']='import_runner'
              sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'backend'))
              from tools.edarsahub_sql_runner import split_sql_batches, validate_sql_safety
              report['stage']='read_sql'
              sql=pathlib.Path(os.environ['MIGRATION_SCRIPT']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
              report['stage']='validate_safety'
              validate_sql_safety(sql,'migrate')
              report['stage']='split_batches'
              batches=split_sql_batches(sql); report['batch_count']=len(batches)
              report['stage']='connect'
              conn=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],autocommit=False)
              cur=conn.cursor()
              for idx,batch in enumerate(batches,start=1):
                  report['stage']='execute_batch'; report['batch']=idx
                  cur.execute(batch)
                  report['batches'].append({'batch':idx,'status':'EXECUTED'})
              report['stage']='rollback_success_path'
              conn.rollback(); report['rollback']='OK'; report['diagnostic_outcome']='ALL_BATCHES_EXECUTED_THEN_ROLLED_BACK'
          except Exception as exc:
              report['exception']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
              report['diagnostic_outcome']='FAILURE_CAPTURED'
              if conn is not None:
                  try:
                      conn.rollback(); report['rollback']='OK_AFTER_FAILURE'
                  except Exception as rb_exc:
                      report['rollback']='ROLLBACK_FAILED: '+repr(rb_exc)
          finally:
              if cur is not None:
                  try: cur.close()
                  except Exception: pass
              if conn is not None:
                  try: conn.close()
                  except Exception: pass
              out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8')
              print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          PY

actions.old:
- name: Postcheck
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os,pymssql,json
          views=['vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360']
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD']);q=c.cursor(as_dict=True);p=','.join(['%s']*4);q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.views WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p}) ORDER BY name",tuple(views));got=[r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()];q.execute('SELECT ClienteID,COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 GROUP BY ClienteID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1');dups=q.fetchall();q.execute('SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360');n360=int(q.fetchone()['n']);q.execute('SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo');nc=int(q.fetchone()['n']);q.close();c.close();print(json.dumps({'views':got,'duplicates':dups,'customer360_rows':n360,'cliente_catalogo_rows':nc,'production_touched':False},default=str));assert set(got)==set(views);assert not dups;assert n360==nc
          PY
actions.new:
- name: R6 physical postcheck after forced rollback
        if: always()
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, pathlib, pymssql
          views=['vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360']
          result={'stage':'postcheck','present_count':None,'views':None,'exception':None}
          try:
              c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD']);q=c.cursor(as_dict=True);p=','.join(['%s']*4);q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.views WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p}) ORDER BY name",tuple(views));got=[r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()]; result['views']=got; result['present_count']=len(got); q.close(); c.close()
          except Exception as exc:
              result['exception']=repr(exc)
          out=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'rrr_gate4_r6_postcheck.json'; out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8'); print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          PY
      - name: Upload R6 durable diagnostic evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rrr-gate4-r6-diagnostic-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r6_diagnostic.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r6_postcheck.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
